recipe.title: Banana muffins
recipe.notes: This recipe is from naturallysweetkitchen.com. The muffins have no added sugar.

i.n: banana, as ripe as possible (about four bananas)

method.s: Whisk together flour, cinnamon, baking soda, baking powder and salt. Set aside.
In another bowl, mix banana, yoghurt, butter, egg and vanilla until fully combined.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and fold together just until the flour begins to disappear.
Gently fold in chocolate chips or blueberries until all the flour is combined. Do not over-mix.
Divide the mixture between the 12 muffin cups. The batter should just reach the top of each cavity.
Bake for 5 minutes, then reduce temperature to 190 deg C and bake for a further 11-14 minutes or until a skewer inserted comes out clean or with just a few crumbs attached.
